parsed.name: 远程代理组件
parsed.description: 用于实验控制软件中的非物理远程代理组件。它负责解析远程调用返回结果，并在服务器端出错时以通用远程异常形式上报，适合分布式实验控制或跨进程仪器访问场景。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical remote proxy component used in laboratory control software. It parses results returned from remote calls and reports server-side failures as generic remote exceptions, suitable for distributed experiment control or cross-process instrument access.

actions.description: 解析并展开远程调用返回结果，必要时还原远程异常信息。
actions.description_en: Parse and unpack the result of a remote call, restoring remote exception information when available.
